claims.author: jeanpablojp
claims.harm: Standalone libbitcoin_consensus build breaks because AssertUnreachable introduces an unwanted dependency from interpreter.cpp into util/check.cpp
claims.quote: calls assertion_fail from util/check.cpp. This file is in libbitcoin_consensus, which should only depend on crypto. Normal builds hide it, bitcoin_common pulls util in anyway, but the riscv job links the lib standalone and breaks.

claims.author: jeanpablojp
claims.harm: The assert_falsy linter regex misses falsy assertions with variable whitespace or 0&&"x"
claims.quote: The message says any falsy literal, but the regex hardcodes the spacing, so assert (false), assert(false ) and assert(0&&"x") all slip through.

claims.author: jeanpablojp
claims.harm: The commit introducing the linter fails CI lint mid-history because the scripted-diff fix is placed in a subsequent commit
claims.quote: The scripted-diff that satisfies this linter is the next commit, so lint is red here, 135 lines. Swapping the two applies cleanly and gives the same tree.
